setup.title: Discover
setup.intro: Install one browser script and what you watch on Bilibili and YouTube shows up on this page. It is all worked out on your own device and never sent anywhere.
setup.step1Title: Step 1: add an extension that can run scripts
setup.step1Body: Violentmonkey is free. Install it, then come back to this page.
setup.step2Body: Press a button below; your browser will ask whether to install it, and yes is the answer.
setup.step3Title: Step 3: connect your browser to Breadcrumb
setup.step3Body: Open the Bilibili home page, click 🔗 on the switch bar at the bottom left, and paste the line below. Do the same once on the YouTube home page.
setup.step3BodyWeb: The script hands over what it recorded whenever you open Breadcrumb. There is nothing else to do.
setup.codeUsed: That line has been used. A new one is on its way.
setup.connected: Connected. Browse Bilibili and YouTube as usual and what you watch will start appearing here.
